snippet.title: Madden 26 Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Madden 26 launches on August 14. Pre-order to play 7 days early: http://x.ea.com/84307

Built From Sundays. Madden NFL 26 brings a new AI-powered machine learning system trained by real play calls and game situations over nearly a decade to deliver more explosive gameplay—with new coach and player-specific traits, authentic playstyles, and more.

Get #Madden26 news: https://linktr.ee/eamaddennfl
